Subject: Kickoff: MSA & Order Form — initial package and asks

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. Attaching our initial MSA draft (AcmeOps_MSA_Draft_v1.docx) and a party matrix (ExhibitA_Parties.xlsx). To keep the contracting timeline tight, can you confirm the following by end of week?

- Primary signing authority for Redwood (name, title, email).
- Billing contact and billing address for invoicing.
- Which Redwood product modules will be in scope for the Order Form (we listed: Inference Hosted API, Dedicated pool). If this differs, please flag.
- Data residency requirements (US/EU/APAC) and whether Redwood will store logs for >90 days.
- SOC 2 Type II (latest report) and encryption-at-rest details or a link where we can download the report.
- Any non-standard IP clauses or third-party dependency calls we should expect.

Target: we need an internal procurement review by May 2 and a countersigned agreement by May 15. If that timeline is too aggressive, let us know. Also looping in our outside counsel, Jeff Kramer, on any legal clarifications.

Attachments: AcmeOps_MSA_Draft_v1.docx; ExhibitA_Parties.xlsx; Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,

Karthik — thanks for the ping and the draft. I reviewed AcmeOps_MSA_Draft_v1.docx and have the following requests/questions for scope prioritization before we prepare a first-pass redline: 

1) Product scope: confirm exact SKUs/modules to be listed in Order Form (hosted inference vs dedicated capacity specifics). Pricing tiers affect service levels and liability caps.
2) Data processing: AcmeOps should confirm if any EU personal data will be sent — if yes, we'll attach our DPA (standard template) and propose SCCs if required.
3) Security evidence: we need access to Acme's completed security questionnaire and their SOC2 report or at least a secure link. Monica: please coordinate secure exchange.
4) IP/License: AcmeOps draft includes a unilateral assignment clause in Section 6.b — that will be a negotiation point. Marking as high priority.
5) Termination for convenience: propose clarifying notice periods and any early-termination fees in Order Form.

Turnaround ETA: if we receive the final party matrix and confirm product SKUs today, I can produce an internal redline (first pass) by Tue Apr 27 EOD. That assumes no unusual carve-outs. For inbound changes from the customer's counsel (Jeffery Kramer), allow 3 business days for review before commercial signoff.

Sign-off block:
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
